_comment: Shared contract between the pinned Render CLI's sandbox FILE transport (lego/cli/sandbox_contract_test.go drives the real pkg/sandbox.Repo against this) and bex-api's handlers, which must be proven to emit exactly these bytes. Sibling of sandbox-exec-contract.json; w7/m150 t001. Update both sides together. Every value here was read from the pinned client at v1.1.3-0.20260909214233-a764810a7682 (pkg/sandbox/files.go, pkg/sandbox/repo.go, pkg/client/client_gen.go), not from help output.

connect._comment: NewConnectSandboxFilesRequest (client_gen.go:20018-20046): POST, no request body, ownerId and path as form-style query params. operation is a path segment, not a body field.
connect.responseMethodIsAuthoritative: the client issues the transfer with the `method` value bex returns in the connect response (repo.go:165,198), so bex chooses it; the fixture exercises PUT for upload and GET for download.

upload._comment: Repo.UploadFile (repo.go:159-190). The body is streamed: a directory is tarred and gzipped on the fly with contentLength -1, so bex must not require Content-Length and must not buffer the whole file.
upload.singleFileBody: raw bytes, not tarred — measured by TestPinnedSandboxFileTransportMatchesBexContract, whose uploaded body is byte-identical to the source file. Only a DIRECTORY is tarred and gzipped.

download._comment: Repo.DownloadFile (repo.go:192-220). No request body. The local filename may come from Content-Disposition; a directory arrives as a tar stream.

archivePolicy._comment: pkg/sandbox/files.go. These are the client's own rules; bex must not rely on the client to enforce them, but must not break them either.
archivePolicy.symlinkPolicy: The pinned upload preserves symlink targets. Download extraction may create an outward-pointing symlink, but os.Root refuses a later read/write through it. Bex's server policy below is deliberately stricter.
archivePolicy.skipsNonRegularNonSymlink: sockets and devices are skipped rather than aborting the archive
archivePolicy.truncationDetected: a truncated archive must not read as success; archive/tar stops at the end-of-archive marker, so the client wraps the body in a terminatedReader and drains after tar EOF to verify the gzip trailer. Raw gzip downloads also verify the trailer before atomically replacing the local destination.

bexServerPolicy._comment: Bex's bounded supported subset, separate from the pinned client's more permissive archive/path behavior. Limits mirror lego/backend/internal/sandboxfiles; server and fixture must change together.
bexServerPolicy.byteLimitAppliesTo: Wire bytes and expanded archive/raw bytes are bounded separately; archive framing counts toward the expanded budget.
bexServerPolicy.paths: Clean absolute non-root paths only. Relative/home paths, traversal, control characters, backslashes, excessive length and depth, pre-existing symlink ancestors and symlink source/destination entries are refused rather than normalized.
bexServerPolicy.rawUpload: application/octet-stream, no Content-Encoding (identity is accepted). Nonempty raw uploads require Content-Length; an empty chunked stream is accepted because the pinned Go client sends zero-byte files that way. A completed upload atomically replaces a regular file; existing directories and symlinks are refused.
bexServerPolicy.directoryUpload: application/x-tar, identity or gzip, unknown Content-Length accepted. Destination must not exist; existing directory trees are refused, never merged.
bexServerPolicy.archiveEntries: Only regular files and directories. Symlinks, hardlinks, special entries, duplicate names, escaping paths, missing preceding parents and non-padding trailing bytes are refused. Ownership and special permission bits are stripped.
bexServerPolicy.downloads: Files and directories always use Content-Encoding: gzip. The gateway writes the success trailer only after validation and a successful executor exit. Missing or interrupted sources produce a status error or failed body read, never clean truncated success.
bexServerPolicy.partialUploads: A private sibling stage is published only after complete validation and executor success. Cancellation joins cleanup under a separate five-second cap; if the sandbox disappears, a hidden stage may remain but the requested destination is not replaced.

nonGoals._comment: Recorded so a later reader does not re-litigate them.
nonGoals.sandboxGroups: deliberate non-goal (approved w7 brainstorm item 3); sandbox-groups commands stay ungraded
nonGoals.appSsh: App SSH restrictions are unchanged by this work
